args.content: Crash report: stats called max() on an empty word list and divided by the word count, so empty input raised ValueError and ZeroDivisionError. Fix: return the documented zero result for empty or whitespace-only text before computing anything. Added a regression test for whitespace-only input. The original suite and the regression test pass.

args.summary: Fixed the crash in text_stats.py, added a regression test, suite green, summary.md delivered.
